content:
marco-peopleops: Heads-up thread for managers: consolidating the comp-change workflow (off-cycle promos, lateral band moves, and small % corrections). Drop any process Qs here.

olivia-dir: For lateral band moves where title changes but no level bump, do we need calibration or just manager + director sign-off?

marco-peopleops: Lateral band moves (title/owner changes but same band) need manager + director sign-off. Calibration only if responsibilities change materially or if comp is adjusted. Note: still run ticket through People Ops so we record the change for audits.

henry-eng: If I request a small comp correction (under 5%) to fix market drift, can managers approve or does Finance need to sign?

marco-peopleops: Corrections <=5% can be approved by manager + director + People Ops. Finance is looped in automatically for any correction that affects monthly run-rate > $5k. Add a short market justification.

tori-ic: What's the process for changing comp mid-quarter vs at quarterly refresh? Any preferred timing to avoid payroll friction?

marco-peopleops: Preferred: align to the next monthly payroll date to avoid retro calculations. If you need mid-quarter mid-month effective date, tick "mid-cycle" and include payroll cutoff confirmation. We'll only approve if Finance signs off on retro calculation and tax implications.

finance-bot: Reminder: Payroll cutoff dates are in the handbook. Retro payroll adjustments require a Finance ticket and may take 2 payroll cycles.

olivia-dir: If a manager wants to split a promotion increase across two months (phased by manager request), is that allowed? How do we document it?

marco-peopleops: Phased increases allowed up to 2 steps. Document plan in the packet and attach director + Finance acknowledgement. In Workday set the first effective date and add a follow-up compensation action for the second tranche (we attach the approval screenshots to the packet).

henry-eng: For off-cycle promotions where equity refresh is recommended, do we issue grants immediately or queue to the next quarterly grant window?

marco-peopleops: Default: queue to next quarterly grant window unless comp committee approves an off-cycle grant. If immediate grant is mission-critical, include business rationale and approval from Head of Finance + Head of People.

tori-ic: Do international hires/promos need separate tax sign-off? I had a teammate in CA and one in DE promoted same week. Any differences?

marco-peopleops: Yes. For international and US-state-specific tax jurisdictions (like CA, NY, DE), we need to run local payroll checks. Add a local payroll ticket at least 10 business days before effective date. We map to local band and include currency conversion notes in the packet.

olivia-dir: What about internal equity checks? Is there an automated compression alert?

marco-peopleops: People Ops runs an internal equity scan for any promotion/proposed comp change. If the delta creates compression >10% with peers or would place comp above band max, packet is flagged and requires comp committee review. Include a peer set in your justification.

henry-eng: If a promotion is rescinded (rare) after announcement, what's the rollback playbook?

marco-peopleops: Rollback steps: 1) Immediate private manager conversation with employee 2) People Ops notifies payroll + recruiting (if headcount reverts) 3) Document reason and timeline in the packet stored in HR records 4) If comp was already paid retro, Finance will calculate recovery/adjustment per policy. Legal must be looped for sensitive cases.

tori-ic: Are managers allowed to promise future raises as part of a development plan? Any phrasing to avoid?

marco-peopleops: Avoid binding language like "guaranteed" or "will be promoted by X date." Use phrasing: "targeted development plan with potential review on [date] contingent on impact metrics." Document expectations clearly.

finance-bot: Note: Any comp change that affects headcount cost > $20k/year requires budget owner acknowledgement in the packet.

olivia-dir: For calibration appeals post-release, what's the timeframe and what evidence is considered new?

marco-peopleops: Post-calibration appeals accepted within 8 business days if you have new, material evidence (customer KPIs, product metrics, or auditable results) that wasn't included originally. Panel: People Ops + 2 senior leaders. Outcome within 7 business days.

henry-eng: Last Q: where do we store the final packet? For audits I want one place.

marco-peopleops: Store final packet in the Promotions folder in Confluence and link the Workday action ID in the packet. We keep PDFs of approvals, payroll screenshots, and any Finance notes. Use the "promo-packet" template to make audit CSVs exportable.

marco-peopleops: I'll update the manager checklist and post the flowchart doc Wed morning. DM me drafts of packets and we'll fast-track urgent ones.
